name: Côtes de Bergerac

limits: For white wine, Muscadelle, Sauvignon Blanc, Sauvignon Gris and Sémillon together: at least 75%
For white wine, Ugni Blanc: at most 25%
For white wine, Chenin Blanc and Ondenc together: at most 20%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
There is no legal or agreed definition of old, so the words promise nothing on their own.

blurb.text: A South West France appellation in the Bergerac area. Reds draw on Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cot and Merlot, and whites on Sauvignon, Sémillon and Muscadelle.
